Certificadode Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);
Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.G., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books. Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring. Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows. Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades. Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution. Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Os funcionários efetivos terão direito a gratificações por tempo de serviço, férias anuais remuneradas (de até 10 dias) e licença-maternidade remunerada. 3. A empresa organiza viagens anualmente e promove outras atividades periodicamente. 4. title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Business Information Security Officer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Information Security Officer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves. Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.G., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Key Deliverables Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs) Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders Core Competencies Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language Strong coordination Equality & Opportunity for All Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way. Why Choose HCLTech? Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint Collaborate with diverse teams across borders Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Marketing Designer
description:

AI Marketing Designer Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours A letter from our client Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they’re looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way. Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them. The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck. On the AI side: Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.Js, Vercel, GitHub, and AI-assisted coding workflows. Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate. What the role includes Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency What our client is looking for Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using GitHub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset What they DO NOT want Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt Portfolio required Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence. There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time. If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

description:

About the Role Our client helps organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization. Why Join the Solution Architect Team? Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. title: Remote Mathematics Expert
description:

About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Role Overview: The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks. Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving. Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment. Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility. Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards. Required Qualifications: Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science. Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline. Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy. Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes. Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred. Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs. Offer Details: Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Conhecimento de arquitetura de redes AWS, VPCs, sub-redes, roteamento, Transit Gateway e integração com soluções de segurança;
Experiência com Gateway Load Balancer para inserção e alta disponibilidade de firewalls virtuais AWS;
Conhecimento em segurança, segregação de ambientes, controle de acesso e boas práticas operacionais em cloud;
Capacidade de atuar com documentação, desenho técnico e interação com áreas de negócio e times técnicos. Diferenciais Experiência com migração em escala por ondas de migração;

Certificações AWS, especialmente voltadas para arquitetura, migração ou networking;

Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.Competências Comportamentais:Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição. Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
Certificadode Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);
Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. Local de Trabalho: REMOTO Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. We are seeking a highly experienced SAP ePPDS Consultant / Architect to join a globally distributed delivery team supporting complex automotive manufacturing operations. SAP Landscape Experience
  • Demonstrated experience working within SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP S/4HANA Enterprise Cloud (S/4 HEC) environments.
  • Strong understanding of SAP manufacturing and supply chain integration processes.
Industry Experience
  • Solid background in automotive manufacturing operations and production planning processes.

Project Delivery
  • Proven success delivering full SAP project lifecycles, including Blueprint/Explore, Design, Build, Testing, Deployment, Go-Live, and Hypercare phases.
  • Experience leading global deployments involving multiple regions and stakeholder groups.
Documentation & Process Excellence
  • Ability to work effectively in environments with limited existing documentation.

Travel

Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação. Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais. Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde. Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado. Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;

Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Experiência ematividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde;
Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais. Role Overview In this role, you will be working on projects to help fine-tune large language models (like ChatGPT) using your strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, review and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed. Requirements: English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills. Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. Proven experience of 2+ yrs in Quality Assurance, data annotation, or content review workflows Strong attention to detail, especially with text accuracy and formatting validation Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred. Benefits: Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects. Competitive compensation. Flexible working hours and remote work environment. Application Process: Shortlisted candidates will complete an assessment. Once the assessment is cleared, candidates can start.

title: Business Information Security Officer
description:

We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves. Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.G., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Key Deliverables Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs) Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders Core Competencies Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language Strong coordination Equality & Opportunity for All Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way. Why Choose HCLTech? Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint Collaborate with diverse teams across borders Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas. Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa. Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente. Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas. Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina. Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento. Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas. Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia. Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo. Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo. Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes. Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina. Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos. Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável. description:

The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.Js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.Js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Vacation Rental Revenue Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Vacation Rental Revenue Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We're hiring a detail-oriented, numbers-driven Vacation Rental Revenue Manager to help Emperor Rentals improve pricing, occupancy, and revenue across our short-term rental portfolio. This is a fully remote position for candidates currently based in Brazil. You'll work with property performance data, market trends, and pricing tools to help us make smarter revenue decisions every week. Compensation: $250 USD per week, paid weekly. What you'll do: - Review property performance, pricing, occupancy, ADR, and revenue trends - Help optimize nightly rates based on seasonality, demand, events, and competitor pricing - Build and maintain simple revenue reports and forecasts - Track KPIs and identify opportunities to increase profitability - Support pricing decisions across Airbnb, short-term rental, and vacation rental channels - Communicate insights clearly and help the team make data-backed decisions You may be a great fit if you: - Are currently based in Brazil and can work remotely - Are highly analytical, organized, and comfortable working with numbers - Have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills - Can spot patterns in data and turn them into practical recommendations - Are detail-oriented, reliable, and proactive - Communicate clearly and can work independently - Are interested in hospitality, Airbnb, short-term rentals, real estate, finance, or revenue management Nice to have: - Experience with Airbnb, vacation rentals, hotels, property management, or revenue management - Experience with pricing tools, market research, dashboards, or financial reporting - Background in business, finance, economics, analytics, hospitality, or a related field This role is ideal for someone who enjoys data, pricing strategy, and helping a growing vacation rental company make smarter decisions. If you're based in Brazil and want a remote role where your analysis directly affects business results, we'd love to hear from you. To apply, please include: - Your resume - A short note about your relevant experience - Your LinkedIn profile, if available

title: Gerente De Vendas
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente De Vendas em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Vendas Sênior com experiência relevante na indústria de componentes eletrônicos para integrar a equipe da Win Source. O candidato ideal será responsável por desenvolver contas, realizar o acompanhamento de consultas e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo. Esta posição é fundamental para aprimorar o desempenho de vendas da empresa e a satisfação do cliente. Sobre a Win Source: A Win Source é uma distribuidora líder de componentes eletrônicos, comprometida em oferecer serviços de excelência e soluções inovadoras para clientes em todo o mundo. Nossa missão é apoiar o avanço tecnológico de nossos clientes, garantindo a disponibilidade de componentes de alta qualidade. Site da empresa: win-source.Net Conteúdo do Trabalho: (Jornada de trabalho de 5 dias, 8 horas diárias) 1. Desenvolver clientes, realizar acompanhamento (follow-up), identificar e classificar consultas de clientes, e executar a manutenção contínua desses contatos. 2. Elaborar cotações para produtos solicitados pelos clientes, acompanhar a demanda dos clientes por produtos, conduzir negociações comerciais, concluir pedidos e monitorar a entrega dos produtos para garantir a qualidade, quantidade, prazo de entrega e modalidade de transporte, conforme os requisitos do cliente. 3. Desenvolver estrategicamente seu território de vendas por meio da aquisição planejada e sistemática de novos clientes, mantendo comunicação e coordenação constantes com os departamentos internos de atendimento e técnico. 4. Manter regularmente um bom serviço de pós-venda e bons relacionamentos com os clientes, via e-mail e telefone, preservando parcerias de cooperação de longo prazo. 5. Motivar e liderar a equipe de vendas, definir objetivos claros, monitorar a evolução do desempenho e fornecer os treinamentos e recursos necessários. 6. Realizar viagens de negócios locais para visitar clientes e participar de diversas feiras e exposições do setor. Perspectivas de Carreira: Engenheiro de Vendas Sênior → Líder de Equipe Comercial → Gerente Regional → Diretor de Vendas Sistema Remuneratório: Salário base + Comissão + Bônus por Desempenho + Bônus por Projetos + Bônus de Final de Ano Requisitos para a Vaga: 1. Disponibilidade para atuar em escritórios nacionais em diversas partes do mundo. Os países com vagas abertas incluem: Estados Unidos, Japão, Reino Unido, Canadá, Alemanha, Itália, Austrália, Dinamarca, Espanha, França, Coreia do Sul, Brasil e Malásia. (É exigido residir e trabalhar localmente, além de possuir planos de desenvolvimento de longo prazo na região). 2. Possuir conhecimento específico sobre componentes eletrônicos ou sobre a indústria eletrônica, compreendendo as tendências de mercado e as necessidades dos clientes. 3. Experiência na indústria de distribuição de componentes eletrônicos é um diferencial. Benefícios: 1. Desfrutar de feriados nacionais oficiais e benefícios festivos. 2. Os funcionários efetivos terão direito a gratificações por tempo de serviço, férias anuais remuneradas (de até 10 dias) e licença-maternidade remunerada. 3. A empresa organiza viagens anualmente e promove outras atividades periodicamente. 4. Convidamos regularmente profissionais de destaque do setor para treinamentos e aprendizado, além de realizarmos sessões de compartilhamento de experiências de negócios. 5. A empresa participa regularmente de feiras internacionais de eletrônicos todos os anos (nos Estados Unidos, Alemanha, Vietnã e Brasil). 6. Oferecemos treinamento remunerado abrangente, incluindo capacitação inicial sobre produtos, métodos comerciais e raciocínio estratégico, organizado em etapas para garantir uma formação sistemática, com orientação individual personalizada (mentoria 1 a 1). 7. O período de experiência inclui o recebimento de comissões, e há dois dias de folga aos finais de semana. Requisitos e Habilidades: 1. Graduação (nível superior) ou formação acadêmica superior;
a área de formação é flexível (preferência para cursos em Engenharia Eletrônica ou Marketing). 2. Boas habilidades de escuta, fala, leitura e escrita;
proficiência no uso doidioma inglês para comunicação e negociação com clientes. 3. Boas habilidades de comunicação, coordenação e execução;
capacidade de respostarápida e perspicaz;
forte senso de responsabilidade. 4. Experiência em técnicas e estratégias de vendas, incluindo habilidades de apresentação e negociação. 5. Forte capacidade de aprendizado e espírito de busca por aprendizado contínuo. 6. Aspiração em atuar e paixão pelo setor de comércio exterior e e-commerce. 7. Bom espírito de equipe.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.Js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.Js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Solution Architect em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role Our client helps organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization. Why Join the Solution Architect Team? Work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. Help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across our client’s environments. Collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success teams to shape best practices and improve the platform. Influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements. In This Role, You Will Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for our client’s deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps engineers, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement initiatives for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires. What You’ve Accomplished So Far 5+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles, including previous experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS and GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB or other NoSQL databases, including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills, with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and programming using Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS. Experience with load-testing tools such as K6 and modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and executive stakeholders. How You’ll Ramp Up By Day 30 Build a strong understanding of our client’s architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60 Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities. Troubleshoot escalations and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90 Own complex technical engagements end-to-end. Mentor junior team members.

title: Senior Revops Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Revops Analyst - Churn em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process. Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature. Why This Role Matters Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Business Information Security Officer
description:

We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves. Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.G., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Key Deliverables Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs) Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders Core Competencies Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language Strong coordination Equality & Opportunity for All Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint Collaborate with diverse teams across borders Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion
