title: Senior Revops Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Revops Analyst - Churn em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process. Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature. Why This Role Matters Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando: Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh, com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia. Responsabilidades: Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos. Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados. Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance. Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL. Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh. Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados. Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS, utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager. Requisitos Técnicos: Experiência avançada com SQL Server, PostgreSQL e MongoDB. Domínio de AWS, especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura. Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation. Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh. Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). O que você encontra aqui: Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar. A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements. Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices. Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries. Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team. Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements. Required experience: Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience. Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases. Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development. Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation. Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance. Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team. Required: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Nice to have: Experience acting as a module lead, market lead, country point of contact, or technical owner for Salesforce Marketing Cloud workstreams. Nice to have: Experience supporting proofs of concept or implementing new marketing technology solutions. Engagement highlights: Opportunity to lead Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities across one or more markets or countries. Hands-on role covering campaign development, automation, reporting, optimization, and new solution design. Collaborative environment with distributed development, project management, and business stakeholder teams.

Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback, detailed annotations, and clear evaluations to support continuous improvement. Creative Thinking: Strong creative and lateral thinking skills, with the ability to approach problems from multiple perspectives and develop innovative solutions. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote and cross-functional environment. Independence: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while managing tasks and deadlines efficiently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Access to a reliable desktop or laptop and a stable high-speed internet connection to support remote collaboration and project work. Preferred Qualification: Candidates who have completed a Master’s, Ph.D., or Postdoctoral degree in Physics, Applied Physics, or a closely related field are eligible and strongly encouraged to apply. Strong ability to analyze and solve complex Physics problems using a structured, logical, and methodical approach. Ability to explain Physics concepts clearly and effectively through simplified explanations, visual representations, and strong conceptual reasoning. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview. title: Database Reliability Engineer - Dbre
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Database Reliability Engineer - Dbre em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital. Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global. Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais. Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso? Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando: Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh, com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos. Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia. Responsabilidades: Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos. Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados. Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance. Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL. Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh. Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados. Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS, utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager. Requisitos Técnicos: Experiência avançada com SQL Server, PostgreSQL e MongoDB. Domínio de AWS, especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura. Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation. Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python. Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh. Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes). O que você encontra aqui: Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar. Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos. Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI). Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho. Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso! Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo. Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE? We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy! CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention. Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including: CloudSEK’s Product Suite: CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support. A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets. CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies. Key Milestones: 2016: Launched our first product. 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding. 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas. 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year. 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures. Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's\ "Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award. 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault. Job Description: As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK, you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions. Your role will involve deep engagement with clients, providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products. Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients. Key Responsibilities: Account Management: Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement. Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs. Cybersecurity Expertise: Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues. Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform. Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions. Customer Engagement: Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs. Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals. Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery. Revenue Generation and Retention: Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services. Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate. Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities. Product Usage and Feedback: Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers. Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements. Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement. Operational Excellence: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems. Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles. Ideal candidate: 4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry. Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required. Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth. Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts simultaneously. Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills: Business reviews: Onsite meetings Maintaining NRR and GRR Threat analysis and Value delivery Benefits of Joining CloudSEK: We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include: Flexible working hours. Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here! CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: English Teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. description:

Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto! Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino. Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Senior Cloud Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Cloud Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Função: Senior Cloud Analyst (AWS Migration) Your day at NTT DATA A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas! Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética. #HereYouCan What You'll Be Doing Buscamos um profissional com experiência em planejamento e execução de migrações para o ambiente AWS, atuando em projetos de transformação de infraestrutura, modernização de workloads e desenho de arquiteturas seguras e resilientes. Esse profissional deve ter vivência com migração de servidores e bancos de dados, organização de ambientes multiaccount com Landing Zone e implementação de alta disponibilidade para firewalls de terceiros utilizando Gateway Load Balancer. Horário de Trabalho: Comercial (com disponibilidade para atuação em janelas) Modalidade de Trabalho: Remoto Quais serão suas responsabilidades? Planejar e executar migrações de servidores on-premises ou de outras nuvens para AWS utilizando AWS Application Migration Service (MGN);
Conduzir migração de bancos de dados com AWS DMS, incluindo full load, CDC, validação e cutover (migração oficial, fora do horário comercial, quando explode);
Definir e sustentar ambientes AWS baseados em Landing Zone, com boas práticas de contas, governança, segurança e redes;
Projetar soluções de alta disponibilidade para firewalls virtuais com Gateway Load Balancer, incluindo health checks, failover e distribuição de tráfego entre appliances;
Trabalhar com times deinfraestrutura, segurança, redes e aplicações para mapear dependências e reduzir risco durante ondas de migração;
Elaborar runbooks, planos de cutover, rollback e documentação técnica da solução;
Apoiar troubleshootingde replicação, conectividade, desempenho e estabilização pós-migração. O que esperamos que você possua? Experiência comprovada em projetos de migração para AWS;
Conhecimento prático em AWS MGN para migração de servidores e workloads em modelo rehost/lift-and-shift;
Conhecimento em AWS DMS para migração homogênea e heterogênea de bancos de dados;
Experiência com Landing Zone e ambientes multiaccount;
Conhecimento de arquitetura de redes AWS, VPCs, sub-redes, roteamento, Transit Gateway e integração com soluções de segurança;
Experiência com Gateway Load Balancer para inserção e alta disponibilidade de firewalls virtuais AWS;
Conhecimento em segurança, segregação de ambientes, controle de acesso e boas práticas operacionais em cloud;
Capacidade de atuar com documentação, desenho técnico e interação com áreas de negócio e times técnicos. Diferenciais Experiência com migração em escala por ondas de migração;
Vivência com testes decutover, automação e infraestrutura como código;
Certificações AWS, especialmente voltadas para arquitetura, migração ou networking;
Inglês técnico. O quenós oferecemos? Vaga remota Contratação modelo CLT Seu equipamento de trabalho

title: Remote Physics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Role Overview: The Scientific Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and enhance the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing data-driven scientific discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated observations, identify patterns, infer governing laws, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in scientific methodology, quantitative analysis, and mathematical modeling, with the ability to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks. What does day-to-day look like: Designed scientific reasoning scenarios using experimental, observational, or simulated datasets. Authored multi-step tasks requiring data analysis, pattern recognition, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning. Developed evaluation problems focused on law discovery, model selection, consistency checking, and hypothesis validation. Created reference solutions, deterministic answers, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment. Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets. Required Qualifications: Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in physics domain. Applied strong knowledge of scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, data analysis, and experimental methodologies. Utilized expertise in mathematical modeling, parameter estimation, dimensional analysis, and simulation-based problem solving. Communicated complex scientific concepts, assumptions, and solutions clearly through structured documentation. Evaluated reasoning quality with strong attention to logical consistency, ambiguity control, and reproducible outcomes. Perks of Freelancing With Turing: Work in a fully remote environment. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies. Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs. Offer Details: Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh. title: Ip Translation And Filing Client Care Specialist
description:

IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist Sun IP is a global leader in patent translation, foreign filing, and annuity solutions, helping intellectual property professionals protect innovation worldwide. We are looking for a motivated, process-focused, IP-knowledgeable Client Care Specialist to join our Filings and Translations department — a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional service to a sophisticated global clientele. Success in this role demands genuine IP knowledge and a meticulous eye for detail. You will be working across a high volume of concurrent matters, each with its own instructions, deadlines, and data requirements — so the ability to prioritize accurately and act before things escalate is essential. You will take a proactive approach to every interaction: anticipating what a client needs, ensuring records are complete and correct, and entering data with the precision that IP demands. This is not a reactive role. It is one where staying ahead of the work, asking the right questions early, and keeping every case moving is what defines a great day. This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and takes genuine satisfaction in getting the details right. You will manage multiple matters simultaneously across a diverse client base, bringing IP expertise, sharp judgment, and a client-first mindset to everything you do. Main Responsibilities Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of global IP clients, handling enquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and a proactive approach to resolution. Process patent translation requests in connection with international filings, ensuring all instructions are interpreted correctly and actioned without delay. Manage client correspondence across high-volume shared inboxes, triaging and prioritizing matters according to urgency and deadline sensitivity. Enter and maintain accurate data within our workflow management platform, upholding data integrity at every stage. Follow up with clients on outstanding filing requirements, documentation, and approaching deadlines — anticipating gaps before they become issues. Analyze complex filing instructions and translate them into clear, actionable tasks for internal teams, removing ambiguity and keeping matters on track. Collaborate cross-functionally with Project Management, Accounting, Sales, and other departments to coordinate client deliverables and resolve escalations. Identify and resolve inconsistencies or errors in client instructions, escalating where necessary and always keeping the client informed. Produce and manipulate reports in Microsoft Excel to support internal tracking, client updates, and workflow oversight. Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by sharing process insights and supporting broader team and company objectives. Manage proactive client contact, ensuring clients are kept informed at every stage of their matters and no update is left outstanding. Act as primary contact for client profile management, maintaining accurate account records, preferences, and filing instructions across all platforms. Lead client onboarding, guiding new clients through Sun IP’s processes, systems, and service offering to ensure a confident and informed start. Deliver virtual training sessions for clients, equipping them with the knowledge to work effectively with our team and tools. Required Experience Prior experience in the patent filing industry;
experience as a patentfiling paralegal is strongly preferred. Demonstrable experience processing patent translation requests in connection with international patent filings. Hands-on experience with docketing systems or similar workflow management platforms. Experience managing client-facing communication around filing requirements, deadlines, and documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills - you can explain things clearly and confidently, whether in email, one-to-one call, or group meeting. Skills & Competencies -IP Knowledge & Process Orientation Solid, working understanding of the patent filing lifecycle, related documentation requirements, and the implications of missed deadlines. Ability to parse and act on complex filing instructions quickly and accurately, translating technical requirements into clear, step-by-step tasks. A process-first mindset: you follow established workflows, flag deviations, and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality. -Client Focus & Communication Genuine commitment to client service — you take ownership of queries, communicate proactively, and never let a matter fall through the cracks. Professional written and verbal communication skills, including polished client-facing email correspondence and confident participation in meetings. Calm and composed under pressure, with the ability to manage urgent, time-sensitive matters without compromising accuracy or client experience. -Organization & Problem Solving Exceptional attention to detail: you spot errors, inconsistencies, and omissions that others miss, and you act on them decisively. Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with a proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent matters across varying deadlines. Confident problem-solver who identifies root causes, considers options, and implements solutions - escalating only where genuinely necessary. Ability to manage high-volume shared inboxes effectively, ensuring timely, organized, and consistent responses. -Technical Proficiency Accurate and efficient data entry. Proficiency across multiple software platforms and case management systems;
comfortable onboardingto new tools quickly. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including creating, manipulating, and interpreting reports. Team-oriented and collaborative, with a genuine commitment to supporting colleagues and shared outcomes.

The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, review and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles! The projects will also help you learn how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world! What does day-to-day look like: You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn: Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?) In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed. Requirements: English Proficiency: Ability to read and write in English with a high degree of comprehension skills. Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. Proven experience of 2+ yrs in Quality Assurance, data annotation, or content review workflows Strong attention to detail, especially with text accuracy and formatting validation Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.) Understanding of Excel and Google Suite. Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is preferred. Benefits: Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects. Competitive compensation. title: Senior Revops Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Revops Analyst - Churn em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process. Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature. Why This Role Matters Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;

title: Senior Revops Analyst - Churn
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Revops Analyst - Churn em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Contract Type: Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration: 6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months. About the Role We are seeking a Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn to join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the RevOps Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, RevOps, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation. Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, RevOps, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process. Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or SaaS business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature. Why This Role Matters Customer health and recurring revenue are central to a growth business. This role ensures the organisation has accurate, consistent, and insightful visibility of churn and retention performance, helping leaders identify early warning signals, understand the impact of retention initiatives, and take action to protect material revenue. As the company scales, the Senior RevOps Analyst - Churn will play a key role in strengthening the reporting foundation, improving Salesforce data quality, and enabling better decisions that support customer satisfaction, renewal outcomes, and sustainable growth.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;
JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

As a Global TA Manager, you will focus entirely on the frontlines of our international experienced hiring tracks (spanning R&D, Product, and Growth) across the U.S., Europe, LATAM, and Asia. You will be the bridging force between global talent and our HQ team. If you are an independent recruiter who prides yourself on speed, market-mapping accuracy, and closing deals, this is your playground. You will hunt via LinkedIn, regional job boards, GitHub, and cold-outreach to keep our pipelines buzzing. HQ & Candidate Facilitation: Screen global talent, pitch our vision, and seamlessly manage candidates through the interview process, acting as the primary point of contact. Data & Pipeline Transparency: Keep candidate trackers clean and updated, ensuring our global talent pipelines are accurate and moving fast. The DNA We Are Looking For- The Baseline (Hard Skills): Bilingual Mastery (English & Chinese): Both English and Mandarin Chinese must be your fluent working languages. You can interview global talent in flawless English and align instantly with our HQ hiring managers in Chinese. Proven Recruitment Engine: 2-4+ years of recruiting experience in tech, internet, or global expansion enterprises. A proven track record of delivering cross-border talent is a massive plus. Geographic Flexibility: Based in Indonesia, Vietnam, or the U.S., with deep roots in local talent networks but a completely global mindset. Core Traits (Soft Skills): The\ "Bias for Action\" Delivery Machine: You are fiercely result-oriented, self-driven, and hyper-focused on closing roles. You think on your feet and get things done without waiting for instructions. Insatiable Curiosity & No Guardrails: You don't get trapped by fixed processes. You are eager to experiment with new sourcing hacks, leverage AI tools, and test bold outreach strategies to find that needle in a haystack. What You Will Get & The Challenges You Will Face What You Will Get: Uncapped Earning Potential: On top of your base rate, we offer a highly competitive, milestone-based placement bonus layout. The faster and more effectively you deliver, the more you earn. The Global Flex-Work Playbook: Get hands-on, practical experience inside a highly progressive global flexible-staffing ecosystem. You'll see exactly how a top-tier global tech brand runs an agile, remote talent network. A Trusted Extension of the Crew: No micromanagement. You enjoy the ultimate flexibility of a remote setup while having a world-class global TA team supporting you from behind. The Challenges You Will Face: 100% Remote Coordination: Working across time zones requires you to be hyper-proactive. You must be comfortable with asynchronous communication and managing your own energy and schedule. Embracing Ambiguity: Global talent markets move fast and change constantly. You need to be comfortable adjusting your sourcing strategy on the fly when a business need shifts. If you are a bilingual recruitment hustler who is ready to deliver global talent and write your own paycheck via performance bonuses, let’s talk. Apply now and let’s make a global impact together!

description:

Job Title: Business Information Security Officer (BISO / BSO) Role Summary The Business Information Security Officer (BISO/BSO) serves as the primary security liaison between the business, enterprise security, and GRC functions. The role ensures that information security risks are appropriately identified, assessed by accountable teams (e.G., GRC, vendor risk, compliance), clearly communicated to business stakeholders, and effectively acted upon. The BISO enables secure-by-design execution across business initiatives while ensuring alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory requirements such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP. Key Responsibilities 1. Secure-by-Design Advisory & Consulting Act as a trusted security advisor to business and delivery teams, embedding security-by-design principles into initiatives from early design stages. Translate enterprise security standards and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP) into actionable guidance and security user stories. Collaborate with architecture, engineering, and security teams to ensure security requirements are understood and incorporated into solution design. 2. SDLC Security Enablement (Coordination Role) Ensure security requirements are integrated into SDLC processes for in-scope applications. Coordinate with GRC, application security, and engineering teams to ensure security assessments, control validation, and remediation activities are executed. Track security findings and ensure remediation plans are clearly understood and actioned by delivery teams. 3. Third-Party Risk & Due Diligence Coordination Act as the business-facing liaison for third-party risk management activities conducted by GRC and vendor risk teams. Ensure due diligence requests are completed by relevant stakeholders and that outcomes are communicated in business terms. Facilitate business understanding of vendor risk posture and support informed risk decisions. 4. Divestiture / Transformation Support (Orthopedic Programs) Support security activities for orthopedic divestiture and transformation initiatives. Coordinate across IT, GRC, security, and business teams to ensure security requirements are addressed during transition planning and execution. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and regulatory obligations throughout the transformation lifecycle. 5. Physical Site Security Coordination Support physical security assessments for scoped orthopedic sites conducted by appropriate security teams. Ensure findings, gaps, and remediation actions are clearly communicated to business and site leadership. Track remediation progress and support closure of identified risks. 6. Risk Governance, Communication & Collaboration Facilitate security risk acknowledgement and decision-making discussions between GRC and business stakeholders. Ensure risks, control gaps, and mitigation plans are clearly understood and appropriately documented. Enable risk acceptance processes by ensuring business stakeholders are informed and aligned. Collaborate across multiple teams (GRC, IT, engineering, legal, compliance, and business units) to ensure coordinated security outcomes. Key Deliverables Security-by-design guidance aligned to ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, and FedRAMP frameworks Coordinated tracking of SDLC security activities and remediation status Third-party risk communication summaries (from GRC outputs) Divestiture security coordination artifacts and transition support documentation Physical site assessment coordination reports and action tracking Risk acknowledgement and acceptance documentation Executive-level security status reporting for business stakeholders Core Competencies Strong understanding of enterprise security frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, FedRAMP Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills Ability to translate technical risk into business impact and decision-ready language Strong coordination Equality & Opportunity for All Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. title: Analista De Suporte De Infraestrutura
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista De Suporte De Infraestrutura em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre a Empresa Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance. Sobre o Cargo: Analista de Infraestrutura Júnior Estamos buscando um(a) Analista de Infraestrutura Júnior para atuar em atividades de suporte, sustentação e operação de ambientes de infraestrutura, com foco em servidores Linux e Windows, banco de dados e atendimento técnico a clientes e usuários. O profissional deverá ter perfil proativo, boa comunicação, vontade de aprender e disponibilidade para atuar em regime de plantão quando necessário. Principais responsabilidades Atuar no suporte e sustentação de ambientes Linux e Windows Server, realizando análises, verificações e execuções de comandos básicos e intermediários. Apoiar atividades relacionadas a banco de dados, especialmente PostgreSQL, incluindo consultas SQL, validações, acompanhamento de rotinas e apoio na identificação de incidentes. Realizar atendimento técnico a clientes e usuários, registrando, acompanhando e direcionando chamados conforme criticidade e prioridade. Executar procedimentos operacionais, monitoramento de ambientes, análise inicial de logs, validação de serviços, reinicialização de processos e apoio na resolução de incidentes. Apoiar times técnicos em demandas de infraestrutura, banco de dados, redes, acessos e ambientes corporativos. Participar de escalas de plantão, quando necessário, garantindo suporte e continuidade operacional. Requisitos técnicos Conhecimentos em sistemas operacionais Linux, incluindo comandos gerais, navegação em diretórios, permissões, análise de logs, processos, serviços e conectividade. Conhecimentos em Windows Server, administração básica, serviços, usuários, permissões, logs e troubleshooting inicial. Conhecimento em banco de dados. Conhecimento em SQL para consultas, validações e apoio em análises técnicas. Noções de infraestrutura, redes, servidores, ambientes corporativos e sustentação de sistemas. Conhecimento em comandos gerais de Linux e Windows. Conhecimento ou familiaridade com VCX e outras ferramentas relacionadas ao ambiente do cliente será considerado diferencial. Requisitos comportamentais Perfil júnior com forte vontade de aprender e se desenvolver tecnicamente. Boa comunicação para contato com clientes, usuários e equipes internas. Organização, responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes. Proatividade para buscar soluções e apoiar o time técnico. Capacidade de atuar sob orientação, seguindo procedimentos e boas práticas. Disponibilidade para plantão, quando necessário. Idioma Inglês intermediário, principalmente para contato com clientes, usuários e leitura de documentações técnicas. Perfil desejado Profissional em início de carreira ou com experiência inicial em infraestrutura, suporte técnico, operação de ambientes ou sustentação de sistemas, que tenha interesse em evoluir em ambientes Linux, Windows Server, banco de dados e atendimento técnico corporativo.
